- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or another computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (so you can write and call me there), plus Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number, then scan a QR code to log me in. Say the word if you want that.
- **My own accounts on websites and services** — e-mail and others, created in my own browser, with passwords and one-time codes in my password store; if a captcha or phone check comes up, I'll ask you.
- **Also** — scheduled jobs, running commands, learning languages, and talking by voice.
